source: GitHub API (stars, license) and repository tree scan for SKILL.md

entries.name: Remotion Agent Skills
entries.summary: Official Remotion skills: best practices, compositions, captions, maps, rendering and licensing.
entries.bestFor: Any Remotion project; prevents web-animation patterns that break in the renderer.
caveats: Remotion requires a company license above its free threshold
No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: HyperFrames
entries.summary: HTML/CSS/GSAP to deterministic MP4, built for coding agents.
entries.bestFor: Web-native explainers and editorial motion without React.
caveats: Different mental model from React; do not mix with Remotion in one project
No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: iart B-roll
entries.summary: Word-timed B-roll graphics derived from what is actually said; original audio is kept.
entries.bestFor: Talking-head footage where each sentence is a potential motion cue.
caveats: Young pack; pin a commit for client work
No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: iart Lower Thirds
entries.summary: Lower thirds with real alpha output: WebM for OBS, ProRes 4444 for Premiere, Resolve and FCP.
entries.bestFor: Editorial names, roles and annotations that must land in a traditional NLE.
caveats: Young pack; pin a commit
Alpha export is the main value; the look is intentionally restrained

entries.name: iart Motion Design
entries.summary: Nine skills on timing, typography, color, composition and Remotion/After Effects fundamentals.
entries.bestFor: Learning the grammar of motion while building a real project.
caveats: Fundamentals-heavy; pair it with a more specific pack
No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: iart Kinetic Typography
entries.summary: Beat-synced animated type for titles, promos and social video.
entries.bestFor: Bold type-led promos and social openers.
caveats: Young pack; pin a commit
Persian/Arabic type needs joining-safe animation; test letter-spacing

entries.name: iart Data Animation
entries.summary: CSV to animated charts with exact numbers on every frame.
entries.bestFor: Numbers, comparisons and trend lines that must stay accurate frame by frame.
caveats: Young pack; pin a commit

entries.name: iart TikTok / Shorts
entries.summary: Vertical short-form structure, hooks and safe areas.
entries.bestFor: First minute of a vertical reel: hook, pacing and platform-safe layout.
caveats: Structural guidance more than rendering code

entries.name: iart Explainer Video
entries.summary: Script to storyboard to narrated explainer rendering.
entries.bestFor: Narrated explainers where the script drives the storyboard.
caveats: TTS-first; less useful when the voice is already recorded

entries.name: Papercut Explainer
entries.summary: Nine skills plus a Remotion library for vertical cut-paper explainer reels.
entries.bestFor: Tactile, hand-made paper language in vertical social video.
caveats: Opinionated about voice and scene structure; adopt the visual primitives, not necessarily the whole editorial flow
No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: GBRO Collage B-roll
entries.summary: Editorial halftone paper-collage B-roll with a three-gate approval workflow.
entries.bestFor: Vox-style beats where one spoken line becomes one collage.
caveats: Chinese-first; the English fork MegaTroll222/VOX-COLLAGE-BROLL is an easier entry point

entries.name: Tactile Collage (HyperFrames)
entries.summary: Portable HyperFrames skill for tactile paper collage and animated scrapbook editing.
entries.bestFor: Paper texture and layered depth in an HTML-native pipeline.
caveats: Low star count; read the skill before client use

entries.name: Cinematic Captions (HyperFrames)
entries.summary: Spatial, editorial captions for HyperFrames.
entries.bestFor: Captions that behave like part of the composition, not a subtitle bar.
caveats: No Persian/Arabic shaping guidance

entries.name: Riso B-roll
entries.summary: Risograph-style information animation for talking-head video at 1080x1920.
entries.bestFor: Two-colour print texture and vertical composition.
caveats: License metadata is unclear; treat as all rights reserved until verified
No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: Motion Graphics Skill Pack
entries.summary: Broad motion-graphics vocabulary for Claude Code and Codex.
entries.bestFor: Reference language for composition and animation.
caveats: License metadata is unclear; review before commercial use

entries.name: Remotion Motion Graphics
entries.summary: Production-ready Remotion title cards, lower thirds and alpha overlays for Premiere/FCP.
entries.bestFor: Remotion-native components without adopting a whole framework.
caveats: No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: Erduo B-roll Loop
entries.summary: SRT-driven dual-backend B-roll: routes each shot to HyperFrames or Remotion, with 152 shot cards.
entries.bestFor: Teams that already have transcripts and want deterministic shot selection.
caveats: Two backends means two sets of dependencies

entries.name: Claude Shorts
entries.summary: Longform to shortform with Remotion-rendered animated captions, segment scoring and cursor tracking.
entries.bestFor: Cutting long recordings into social clips with animated captions.
caveats: No explicit RTL guidance

entries.name: Arabic / RTL Motion Graphics
entries.summary: RTL motion graphics with Remotion: reels, explainers and logo reveals.
entries.bestFor: The only reviewed pack that treats RTL as a first-class constraint.
caveats: Small repo; read the skill before relying on it
Arabic-first; Persian needs its own normalization and font test

entries.name: Claude Code Video Toolkit
entries.summary: Full video workspace: Remotion, ElevenLabs, FFmpeg and Playwright skills, slash commands, components and brand themes.
entries.bestFor: A studio that wants one opinionated house style from day one.
caveats: Wants to be the project root; porting it into an existing Remotion codebase creates two competing structures
No RTL guidance

entries.name: Claude Video Kit
entries.summary: 9:16 explainer pipeline with a script-bound review gate and a final release gate.
entries.bestFor: Auditable, reproducible explainers.
caveats: TTS-first; less useful when the voice is already recorded
No RTL guidance

entries.name: Edit Reel
entries.summary: Local-first Python editor with a paper-and-objects aesthetic and a serious audio chain.
entries.bestFor: Stealing a coherent paper aesthetic and a broadcast audio chain.
caveats: Very low star count; read the code before trusting it with client footage

entries.name: FireRed OpenStoryline
entries.summary: Intention-driven editing agent: describe the edit, it plans and executes.
entries.bestFor: Conversational editing surfaces.
caveats: Large surface area; evaluate on a short clip first
No RTL guidance

entries.name: Chengfeng Video Cut
entries.summary: Video-cutting skills with strong shot-selection and pacing logic.
entries.bestFor: Pacing and shot selection, even outside Chinese-language content.
caveats: Chinese-first documentation

entries.name: OpenChatCut
entries.summary: Local-first conversational editor with a multi-track timeline, agent skills, MCP and Remotion rendering.
entries.bestFor: A local editing surface with an agent.
caveats: AGPL network-copyleft: read the license if you expose it as a service
No RTL guidance

entries.name: Baocut
entries.summary: Transcribe, subtitle, translate, dub, cut and animate on an editable timeline.
entries.bestFor: Multilingual subtitles and dubbing on a timeline.
caveats: License metadata is unclear; treat as all rights reserved until verified

entries.name: Ghost Editor
entries.summary: Raw talking-head take in, finished reel out. Focused editing agent.
entries.bestFor: A clear reference for cut logic and caption timing.
caveats: Narrow scope by design

entries.name: Cut Video
entries.summary: Removes silences, fillers and dead air while preserving laughs and comedic pauses.
entries.bestFor: Tightening a first cut before motion is added.
caveats: Audio cleanup only; pair it with a motion pack

entries.name: YouTube Clipper
entries.summary: Semantic chapters, clips, bilingual subtitles and burned-in captions.
entries.bestFor: Long interviews and podcasts as the source.
caveats: Built around YouTube sources

entries.name: Video Recap
entries.summary: Long videos to narrated recaps with shot detection and editable CapCut drafts.
entries.bestFor: Narration-driven pacing and recaps.
caveats: CapCut-centric delivery

entries.name: Lottie Generator
entries.summary: Production-ready Lottie animation from code.
entries.bestFor: Logo animation, UI micro-motion and vector assets.
caveats: Limited to what the Lottie renderer supports

entries.name: Pixel2Motion
entries.summary: Raster logo to smooth SVG animation with motion QA.
entries.bestFor: Brand reveals from an existing raster logo.
caveats: Logo-specific; not a general motion pack

entries.name: Explainroo
entries.summary: Local voice (Kokoro), Whisper timing and a canvas renderer for explainers.
entries.bestFor: Fully local explainer production.
caveats: Local TTS quality varies by language; Persian may need another voice

entries.name: Claude Motion Design
entries.summary: Pure-code motion design with HTML, Playwright and FFmpeg.
entries.bestFor: Motion design without React or a framework.
caveats: HTML render path; verify frame determinism

entries.name: Bang Motion
entries.summary: Browser motion graphics: openers, promos, bumpers and kinetic type.
entries.bestFor: Short promos and channel bumpers.
caveats: Browser-first; check the capture path stays deterministic

entries.name: Hardcore Motion Graphics
entries.summary: Motion-graphics director plans, storyboards and shot direction.
entries.bestFor: Direction and storyboard language for personal projects.
caveats: Noncommercial license: commercial use needs a separate license
GitHub metadata says NOASSERTION; the LICENSE file is PolyForm Noncommercial

entries.name: Awesome Claude Video Skills
entries.summary: Roughly 500 video repositories, read and security-graded, plus a 16-skill comparison test.
entries.bestFor: Finding a niche pack outside this catalog.
caveats: A catalog, not an installable skill

entries.name: EffectCraft Motion
entries.summary: JSON spec to vertical 9:16 motion graphics with text-derived timing.
entries.bestFor: Spec-first vertical motion with a small dependency surface.
caveats: Small repo; the spec-first pattern is the main value

entries.name: OpenMontage
entries.summary: Agentic production system with 12 pipelines and more than 100 tools.
entries.bestFor: Large agentic productions with room for a heavy stack.
caveats: AGPL-3.0; catalog flags it CAUTION
Very large surface area; start on a short clip

entries.name: OneTake
entries.summary: Continuous-camera films where every beat grows from the previous one.
entries.bestFor: Long, unbroken camera moves and cinematic transitions.
caveats: License metadata is unclear

entries.name: Manim Skill
entries.summary: Manim animation workflow for math, science and diagrams.
entries.bestFor: Mathematical and scientific explanation.
caveats: Slow renders; typography and brand systems are manual
No RTL guidance
